name: Hentai na Ore wa Shinshi ni Narazaru o Enai -The Importance of Creating an Environment Conducive to Be, or Not to Be.-
original_name: 変態な俺は紳士にならざるを得ない – The importance of creating an environment conducive to be, or not to be. –
source:
One average day, Imari, friend of my little sister Iori, appears before me seeking advice. It turns out that Imari is being troubled by a stalker.
and thus, I end up becoming her personal body guard...

[from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE208370.html]DL Site[/url]]
